description: NaAsSe₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pc space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-16°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.96-3.32 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-21°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.95-3.06 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-17°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.95-3.05 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-16°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.97-3.32 Å. There are four inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Se atoms. There are a spread of As-Se bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.54 Å. In the second As site, As is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Se atoms. There are a spread of As-Se bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.50 Å. In the third As site, As is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Se atoms. There are a spread of As-Se bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.55 Å. In the fourth As site, As is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Se atoms. There are a spread of As-Se bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.50 Å. There are eight inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one As atom. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to three Na and two As atoms to form distorted SeNa₃As₂ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SeNa₄As square pyramid, corners with two equivalent SeNa₃As₂ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with three SeNa₄As square pyramids. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to four Na and one As atom to form SeNa₄As square pyramids that share corners with four SeNa₄As square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one SeNa₃As₂ trigonal bipyramid, and edges with three SeNa₃As₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded to three Na and two As atoms to form distorted SeNa₃As₂ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SeNa₄As square pyramid, corners with two equivalent SeNa₃As₂ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with three SeNa₄As square pyramids. In the fifth Se site, Se is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two As atoms. In the sixth Se site, Se is bonded to four Na and one As atom to form SeNa₄As square pyramids that share corners with four SeNa₄As square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one SeNa₃As₂ trigonal bipyramid, and edges with three SeNa₃As₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the seventh Se site, Se is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two As atoms. In the eighth Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one As atom.
